note: Code animation per art key (owner pick anim_route 2026-10-26, ART-SPEC 3.9.8). Coordinates = texels of the still, origin top-left (as ART-SPEC names areas). Effects: sway/shift/scroll/line are baked into the still frames; glow/flicker/smoke/toggle/layer are overlays. Layers resolve the artist files <key>_layer_<part>@64.png, <key>_layer_<part>_<pose>@64.png, <key>_base@64.png, <key>_layer_front@64.png; until all of them are delivered the still is used and effects marked onlyWithoutLayers stand in. Read by CodeAnimLibrary / CodeAnimator.
